algorithm: If n == 0, return a copy of `a`.
If n > len(a), return an empty list.
Otherwise, compute the n-th discrete forward difference along the specified axis.
constraints: n must be an integer from 0 to 5.
If n > len(a), the result is empty unless n = 0.
If n == 0, return a copy of `a`.
edge_cases: n >= len(a): return an empty list unless n = 0.
a is empty: return an empty list.
inputs: a is a one-dimensional list of integers, possibly empty. n is an integer from 0 to 5.
output: A list of integers, possibly empty, with the same shape as `a` except along the specified axis, where the dimension is reduced by `n`. The type is the same as the type of the difference between any two elements of `a`.
purpose: Compute the n-th discrete forward difference of a one-dimensional array.
